meta.name: google-agents-cli-deploy
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "deploy an agent", "deploy my ADK agent", "set up CI/CD", "configure secrets", "troubleshoot a deployment", or needs guidance on Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, or GKE deployment targets, or binding an agent to an Agent Gateway. Covers deployment workflows, service accounts, rollback, and production infrastructure. Applies to any framework agents-cli deploys (ADK, LangChain, ...). Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Do NOT use for agent API code patterns (ADK: use google-agents-cli-adk-code), evaluation (use google-agents-cli-eval), or project scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold).

howto.what: 它会帮你把 agent 部署到 Agent Runtime、Cloud Run 或 GKE,配置密钥、CI/CD 与服务账号,排查看部署问题,并在真正执行部署前先征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你提到“部署 agent”“配置密钥”“搭建 CI/CD”等需求,或要选择部署目标、排查部署故障时接管;不负责 API 代码、评估与脚手架。

howto.what_en: It helps you deploy agents to Agent Runtime, Cloud Run or GKE, configure secrets, CI/CD and service accounts, troubleshoot deployments, and asks for your approval before running the deploy.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to deploy an agent, configure secrets or set up CI/CD, or need to choose a deployment target or debug a deployment. Not for agent API code, evaluation or scaffolding.
